body: Fixed. Check mode now handles missing or malformed generated runtime gate artifacts without throwing: it emits a fail validator result with check_mode.status=fail, failure_count=1, and a diagnostic code for missing or malformed gate artifacts. Added focused CLI regression coverage for both cases.
Fixed. Replaced the per-row qaRows.some(...) scan with a Set of Wave 1 question keys so the filter is O(N + M) while preserving the existing classification behavior.
